issues.extracted: Meetings, seminars, and dues (detail_category dues, training and travel)
issues.issue: [fixed] Cemetery 1,980 is on the Transportation row, not Meetings, seminars, and dues. Row totals confirm it: Meetings total 16,552 has no Cemetery amount, and Transportation total 19,710 = 11,994 + 5,689 + 47 + 1,980. The label and detail_category are wrong (should be Transportation / fuel, as used for the other Transportation lines). The amount is correct.

The report counts the Cemetery department in Public works: Cemetery total 67,234 less principal 2,973 = 64,261 = General Fund Public works on p5. The detail calls Cemetery health/welfare, so the General Fund function split doesn't tie to the statement. Also, receipts-side disbursements[2] 'Public works' 323,156 (streets/highways) includes this 64,261 of cemetery spending.

issues.on_page: Total Enterprise column includes Golf Fund (expenses 314,724, p2/p9)
issues.issue: Every object line in the enterprise total column is categorized utilities, but Golf (culture/recreation) is 314,724 of the 3,068,746.

The enterprise funds also pay 333,000 of franchise fees as an operating expense (Electric 249,750, Water 56,610, Trash 26,640). The Golf Fund's 120,000 looks like an internal payment from other city funds, not a tax, and may be a transfer in substance. A person should decide; decision_needed is empty.
